caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric with a light brown or tan background, covered in a repeated floral pattern. The flowers are primarily rendered in shades of pink, red, and purple, with some blue or bluish-lavender flowers interspersed throughout. Green leaves and stems connect and surround the flowers, weaving through the composition in various directions. The edges of the fabric are slightly irregular and uneven, and the design fills almost the entire surface area. The illustration is centered on a plain, off-white background, with the artist’s name, "Marie Luttrell," and the date "'40" written in small letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Calico
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
